about: Sukrara Aura's Connect IQ store listing (docs/20-publishing.md › Connect IQ store: the listings). The texts are description-<lang>.txt (plain text, at most 4000 characters; tools/release/test_release.py counts them in UTF-8 bytes); the images are made by assets/brand/sukrara/connectiq/render.mjs into `images`: icon-500.png, hero-<lang>.png (`kind`, the kind of app in the store's words, the title and `tagline`), screen-<id>.png for each of `screenshots`, in this order. release.py's garmin step prints it for the upload.
category: Watch face (the manifest's type; any category the form asks for: Health & Fitness, or the closest it offers)
